company_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites. Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

summary: PISQRE LEARNING was born out of a real and recurring problem we observed in the education ecosystem. Over the years, we noticed that many students struggle to truly understand the concepts taught in colleges and institutions. While professors and doctors are highly knowledgeable, they often have limited time to address individual doubts. As a result, students are left with unresolved questions gaps that teaching assistants (TAs) are also sometimes unable to bridge. We repeatedly saw students reaching the final stages of their academic journey with the pressure to score well in exams, yet lacking conceptual clarity. Despite hours of studying, the absence of strong fundamentals often affected both their confidence and performance. One night, around 1:00 AM, reflecting on these challenges and the repeated concerns shared by students, the idea of building a better learning platform took shape a platform designed specifically to connect students with tutors who prioritize concepts, clarity, and understanding over shortcuts. We consistently encountered learners expressing similar concerns that some tutors could solve problems but could not explain the underlying concepts clearly. This reinforced our belief that knowing answers is not the same as understanding concepts.That realization became the foundation of PISQRE LEARNING. Our approach is simple yet strict: conceptual clarity comes first. Tutors are evaluated for their depth of understanding before engaging with students, ensuring that learning is meaningful, structured, and future-ready. Today, PISQRE LEARNING stands as a platform built on real experiences, real student challenges, and a commitment to restoring depth, clarity, and trust in education.
